cover.label: Week 10 QB rankings · PlainScore, not hype
cover.line1: The NFL's best QB so far isn't Burrow or Lawrence.
cover.sub: And he's paid less than both.

slides.title: Best in the league.
slides.hook: 98th percentile in EPA per play and in yards per dropback.

slides.title: The top 3 earn $53M-$55M.
slides.hook: Purdy is #1 and the cheapest of the three. Mahomes, at $63.1M, is #4.

slides.title: He has help up front.
slides.hook: Five 49ers linemen rank top 3 at their spot. Together they make less a year than Purdy.

slides.source: PlainScore: play-rating percentile among qualified players at his position, 2026 through Week 10, from nflverse play-by-play (CC BY 4.0). Pay is average per year, shown only when a named report or the CBA rookie scale confirms it (Purdy: CBS Sports).

story.title: The NFL's best QB so far?
story.text: Not Burrow (95). Not Lawrence (92). And he's paid less than both.
